assignments.name: text

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { error: "Missing required fields: title, sources. For update mode, pageUrl is required." } }}

parameters.text:
={{ "You are a technical writer creating a Confluence page.

Mode: " + $json.mode + "
Template instruction: " + ($json.template === "release-notes" ? "Write a Confluence release notes page. Start with a short executive summary, then list the most important changes, any risks or breaking changes, and action items. Use Confluence storage-format HTML." : $json.template === "wiki" ? "Write a Confluence wiki page that organizes knowledge clearly with sections and headings. Use Confluence storage-format HTML." : $json.template === "doc" ? "Write a Confluence documentation page that is structured, readable, and easy to scan. Use Confluence storage-format HTML." : "Write a general Confluence page that presents the available information clearly. Use Confluence storage-format HTML.") + "
Additional instructions: " + ($json.instructions || "none") + "

" + ($json.existingBody ? "

Existing page body (update this, do not rewrite from scratch):
" + $json.existingBody : "") + "

Source data:
" + $json.sourceText + "

Generate a complete Confluence storage-format HTML body. Output only the HTML." }}

options.systemMessage:
You write clean XHTML-compatible standard HTML for a Confluence page body. Use only standard tags such as h1, h2, h3, p, ul, ol, li, table, thead, tbody, tr, th, td, code, pre, strong, em, a, br, hr. Close every non-void tag. Write void tags as self-closing XHTML tags:
and
. Escape < and > inside code and pre content. Do NOT use Confluence-specific XML, ac:structured-macro, ac:macro, ac:parameter, or any ac: namespace tags. Do not use script, iframe, event-handler attributes, or markdown formatting. Do not wrap the output in markdown code fences. Output only the HTML body content.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { type: "page", id: $json.pageId, title: $json.title, body: { storage: { value: $json.body, representation: "storage" } }, version: { number: $json.existingVersion + 1 } } }}

={{ { type: "page", title: $("Normalize Input").first().json.title, status: "draft", body: { storage: { value: $json.body, representation: "storage" } }, space: { key: $("Normalize Input").first().json.spaceKey }, ancestors: $("Normalize Input").first().json.parentPageId ? [{ id: $("Normalize Input").first().json.parentPageId }] : undefined } }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: "draft_saved", title: $("Normalize Input").first().json.title, spaceKey: $("Normalize Input").first().json.spaceKey, pageId: $json.pageId, pageUrl: $json.pageUrl } }}
